name: CSS Action
note: R13.17, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.43. One refit only — 92 less the 4 for going without PL-F gives the Y160 hull at 88. No PPD, no plasma-S, and its phaser-3s are standard rather than a refit, so this is the plainest of the ISC line. Size class FOUR, which matters for R13.1C: a destroyer is itself a 'size-class-4 or larger ship'. No balcony note on this sheet, unlike the CA and CL. The Y180 Sabot refit (+4) is absent for the usual reason: FP11.0 lives in Module R10, out of scope.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE PLASMA-F TORPEDOES 'C' AND 'D'. Only C and D — A and B are base armament. THIS SHIP IS THE PROOF THAT iscRearFiring IS PER LAUNCHER AND NOT DERIVABLE FROM PLASMA TYPE: all four of its torpedoes are plasma-F, but only C and D are rear-firing. The sheet's own pseudo-plasma box says the same thing, listing pseudos for A and B and none for C or D, which is R13.1C's 'these rear-firing torpedoes do not have PPTs' drawn rather than written.
